avatar.name: G$LIDE Esiah avatar
avatar.canonical_direction: A stylized human portrait with realistic adult human facial proportions and anatomy, rendered as an intentionally unreal layered paper-cut/ink illustration in the G$LIDE palette. The unreal quality comes from paper texture, cut-paper edges, ink/sketch detail, graphic lighting and navy/gold/electric-blue color treatment — not from cartoon anatomy.
required_traits: normal human mouth and jaw proportions
recognizable consistent facial geometry across productions
deep navy, G$LIDE gold and electric-blue treatment
avatar.thumbnail_rule: When the avatar is used in a thumbnail, preserve realistic human proportions even under a strong reaction. Use pose, lighting, paper layers and composition for drama instead of distorting the face into a cartoon.
avatar.in_video_rule: Any appearance of the G$LIDE avatar inside the video must follow the same canonical facial treatment as thumbnails. Do not switch avatar styles between scenes or episodes.

image_generation_rule: If any generated image contains the G$LIDE avatar or a representation of Esiah, the avatar policy is mandatory. If the image does not contain the avatar, retain the G$LIDE palette and premium paper-cut/technical-explainer visual language without forcing a person into the scene.
qa_rule: A generated avatar that reads primarily as a cartoon/toon/animated-film character is a brand failure and must not pass release QA.
